notes:
Company overview: CodeGlide Studio — VS Code-first startup building an AI-powered coding companion targeted at mid-market developer teams and internal platform engineering groups.
Primary product: a VS Code extension that provides streaming inline completions, multiline refactors, and contextual suggestions tied to repo indexer. Extension must support low-latency streaming to preserve typing feel (<=50ms token latency target for local completions).
Recent interactions:
- 2026-02-20: Intro call (Jordan Lee) — high-level product fit. They demoed VS Code extension; emphasized sticky latency and auth model.
- 2026-03-02: Technical demo w/ SE (Aisha Khan) — walked through current proxy architecture, token fan-out, and burst patterns (peak: 600 concurrent devs internal trial).
- 2026-03-08: Security sync — initial SSO requirements and legal NDA sent. Fireflies: ff_20260308_003.
Requirements summary:
- Workloads: streaming completion (primary), inline suggestions, repo-level embeddings for code search (secondary), model pinning per-customer and per-workspace.
- Latency/throughput: avg per-token latency <=60ms; 99th <=120ms. Concurrent sessions up to 600 for trial; estimate 3k monthly active devs for 12-month horizon.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller tuned code models for cheap low-latency completions; want ability to fallback to larger models for complex refactors. Must support deterministic version pinning and rollback.
- Routing/fallback: need policy-based routing (fast cheap model for interactive typing, fallback to 'strong' model for heavy refactor calls) and graceful degradation when capacity saturated.
- Auth & rate limits: extension uses org SSO (SAML/SCIM). They implement short-lived tokens. Need rate-limit handling guidance for token fan-out and per-user burst allowances.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 and ISO expected; require audit logging, KMS for key management, and EU data residency option for customers.
Technical concerns noted on calls:
- Streaming protocol: they use gRPC-web in the extension; asked about Redwood streaming compatibility and ability to do incremental token patches to the editor without full-response buffering.
- Rate limit semantics: want per-organization and per-workspace quotas plus per-user soft limits to avoid throttling during pair-programming sessions.
- Billing & cost controls: seeking Optimize recommendations to tune batching/quantization for code-models and to understand per-completion unit economics.
Copy from customer: "We need completions to feel instantaneous — anything that adds jitter kills adoption." — lead product.
Next steps (short):
- Schedule infra deep-dive with runtime team and extension engineers (target week of 2026-03-15).
- Send security questionnaire + sample SAML metadata. 
- Provide sample streaming demo (gRPC-web -> Redwood hosted API) and rate-limit whitepaper.
Decision factors: latency SLO proofs, model pin rollback API, clear per-burst pricing, SAML + SCIM support, EU residency option.
Potential upsell: Dedicated pools for large enterprise customers and Optimize add-on for cost tuning.
